'''Bruce Savin''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Rogue 9 from Gloucester, UK. The published fan table marks the slot Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.

Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010115110100/http://www.decipher.com/volunteers/squadrons/regions/kiffex.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="sm-fan">[https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/SMs.html Squadron Members], geocities.ws/plarathas (Corellian Engineering Corporation fan site). Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support).
